issues.title: Suboptimal sampling temperature
issues.description: Temperature was set to 0.8, yielding only 60% unique samples for sudoku (23.5/39). Increased to 1.2, which improved diversity to 26.9/39 unique samples and boosted sudoku accuracy from 66.13% to 67.20% (+1.07pp). Temperature sweep on calibration set (50 instances) confirmed monotonic improvement: 0.8->60%, 1.0->64%, 1.2->68% for sudoku.

issues.title: Missing stop sequence for sudoku task
issues.description:
The original best-of-k script used stop=["

"] for countdown but stop=None for sudoku. This caused the model to waste tokens generating continuation text (next few-shot example) after the 4-line grid answer, instead of cleanly terminating. Fixed by adding stop=["

"] for both tasks.

summary: Optimized Qwen2.5-7B best-of-k sampling by increasing temperature from 0.8 to 1.2 and adding stop=["\n\n"] for sudoku. Mini Sudoku accuracy improved from 66.13% to 67.20% (+1.07pp), narrowing the gap with Dream from 11.47pp to 10.40pp. Countdown accuracy was essentially unchanged (39.33% -> 39.13%, within noise). The improvement is modest but consistent across all 3 seeds. Higher temperature increased sample diversity substantially (sudoku: 23.5 -> 26.9 unique out of 39 samples).
